scripts.db:generate: npx prisma generate && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma-mongodb/schema.prisma && rm -rf ../../node_modules/.prisma && cp -r node_modules/.prisma ../../node_modules/.prisma 2>/dev/null && rm -rf ../../node_modules/@prisma/mongodb-client && cp -r node_modules/@prisma/mongodb-client ../../node_modules/@prisma/mongodb-client 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.db:test:push: dotenv -e .env.test -- npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && rm -rf ../../node_modules/.prisma && cp -r node_modules/.prisma ../../node_modules/.prisma 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.pretest: npm run db:test:push && dotenv -e .env.test -- npx prisma db seed
scripts.generate: npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma-mongodb/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate: npx prisma migrate dev --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma
